tips.text: Run the Tier 2 Arcana vault, not the plain one; its odds are about double and its final stage is the only good Rivet source.
Keep every Guard and Rivet that drops, then spend 6,000 standing on whatever is still missing, usually the Rivet.
Join an Arum or Sporothrix farm squad for Arcana vaults; if public squads keep extracting after the vault stage, run it solo.
Check the Isolation Vault exit before you rely on a run; a broken exit can void its rewards.
Treat the Necraloid standing grind as the real cost; it is a known, finite amount.
